title: Robust Length Prediction: A Perspective from Heavy-Tailed Prompt-Conditioned Distributions
authors: Jing Wang; Yu-Yang Qian; Ke Xue; Chao Qian; Peng Zhao; Zhi-Hua Zhou
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Length prediction, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Existing output-length predictors for LLM serving train on a single sampled length per prompt as if it were the prompt's true length. Under a fixed model and decoding setup, however, repeated generations of the same prompt induce a prompt-conditioned distribution with median noise radius of 21.7-42.9 tokens and max-to-median ratios up to 4.03x, so single-sample supervision is misaligned with the heavy-tailed nature of LLM outputs and corrupts the training signal.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM serving 的 output length 預測器在訓練時，將每個 prompt 採樣到的單一輸出長度當作該 prompt 的真實標籤。然而在固定模型與 decoding 設定下，同一 prompt 多次重新生成所得的 prompt-conditioned 分佈呈現 21.7-42.9 tokens 的 median noise radius，max-to-median 比率最高達 4.03x。單一樣本監督與 LLM 輸出本身的重尾特性錯位，污染了訓練信號。

key_innovation.en: Formulates prompt-only length prediction as robust estimation from prompt-conditioned length distributions (ProD). Two variants: (i) ProD-M draws r independent generations per prompt and uses their sample median as the training label, aligning supervision with the Bayes-optimal conditional median under MAE; (ii) ProD-D projects the same repeated samples onto a K-bin histogram and trains the predictor with soft cross-entropy against the full empirical distribution. Both reuse the served LLM's last-layer hidden state and need no auxiliary model at inference time.
key_innovation.zh: 將 prompt-only length prediction 重新定義為從 prompt-conditioned 長度分佈進行的 robust estimation (ProD)。兩個變體：(i) ProD-M 對每個 prompt 採樣 r 次獨立生成，取樣本中位數作為訓練標籤，使監督訊號對齊 MAE 下的 Bayes-optimal conditional median；(ii) ProD-D 將同樣的多次採樣投影至 K 個 bin 的 histogram，並以 soft cross-entropy 訓練預測器擬合完整經驗分佈。兩者皆重用 serving LLM 最後一層的 hidden state，inference 時不需額外輔助模型。

key_improvements.en: ProD-D achieves the lowest average MAE: 56.78 on Qwen-2.5-7B and 44.31 on Llama-3-8B across Math, Coding, LongSequence, and Chat scenarios, beating the strongest baseline TRAIL-Last (64.23 / 49.08) by 11.6% and 9.7% respectively. Reduces average prediction error by up to 25% over previous SOTA. Advantage persists under fixed total inference budgets, confirming gain comes from supervision-target design rather than predictor complexity.
key_improvements.zh: ProD-D 在 Math、Coding、LongSequence、Chat 四個情境上取得最低平均 MAE：Qwen-2.5-7B 為 56.78、Llama-3-8B 為 44.31，分別較最強 baseline TRAIL-Last（64.23、49.08）改善 11.6% 與 9.7%。整體平均預測誤差較先前 SOTA 降低達 25%。在固定總 inference budget 條件下優勢依舊維持，顯示提升來自監督目標設計而非預測器複雜度。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA Tesla A100 80GB, Intel Xeon Platinum 8358
reported_accuracy: MAE 30.35 / 31.76 / 51.41 / 113.60 (Qwen Math/Coding/LongSeq/Chat); MAE 19.57 / 26.61 / 37.68 / 93.39 (Llama Math/Coding/LongSeq/Chat) for ProD-D

scope_assumptions.en: Focuses on the prompt-only static prediction setting (predict before decoding begins); the iterative refinement during decoding is acknowledged as a future extension. Theoretical guarantee derived via a simplified linear surrogate with bounded representations and symmetric, weakly concentrated noise. Predictors are single-shot at inference time, even though training uses repeated sampling (16 generations per prompt; temperature 0.8).
scope_assumptions.zh: 聚焦於 prompt-only 的靜態預測情境（在 decoding 開始前做預測）；decoding 過程中的迭代式 refinement 被列為未來工作。理論保證係透過簡化的線性 surrogate 推導，假設表徵有界、雜訊對稱且弱集中。Inference 時為 single-shot，雖然訓練使用 repeated sampling（每個 prompt 16 次生成、temperature 0.8）。
